Set it up once, then relax

  1. Get your instant quote. Pick your service and choose your frequency on the Frequency step.
  2. We start strong. If it's been a while since your last professional clean, we recommend a deep clean first so every visit after starts from a clean baseline.
  3. We keep it that way. We automatically schedule your visits and try to send the same trusted cleaner every time. Need to pause or cancel? Just let us know with at least 48 hours' notice.

Every recurring visit includes

  • Kitchen counters, backsplash, sink and appliance exteriors cleaned
  • Microwave wiped inside and out
  • Bathrooms cleaned and sanitized: toilets, tubs, showers, sinks and mirrors
  • Dusting of reachable surfaces in every room
  • Floors vacuumed and mopped throughout
  • Trash emptied and beds made
  • Rotating detail tasks: we work through baseboards, ceiling fans, door frames and other detail areas on a rotation, so your home stays deep-clean fresh over time

Add-ons any visit: inside the oven, inside the refrigerator, inside cabinets, interior windows, laundry.

Consistency you can count on

  • The same cleaner whenever possible. They learn your home, your preferences and your pets.
  • Pet-friendly. Pets shed every day, so regular visits keep the hair in check. See our pet-friendly house cleaning.
  • Background-checked team members you can trust with a key or entry code.
  • Your products or ours. We use professional-grade, eco-conscious products — or the ones you prefer.
  • Flexible. Pause for vacations, add a deep clean before the holidays, or change your frequency.
  • Easy to reach. Open seven days a week, 8:30 AM–7:30 PM.

"We were referred to this cleaning company after our last cleaning lady retired, and I couldn't be happier!" — K. McGee

Is there a contract?

No long-term contract. You can pause or cancel any time — we just ask for at least 48 hours' notice before a scheduled visit.

How much do I save with recurring cleaning?

Recurring clients get reduced rates compared to one-time cleans. You'll see your exact price for each frequency in the instant quote.

Which frequency is best?

For most homes, every other week. Busy households with kids or pets often prefer weekly; tidy homes can do well with monthly.

Do I have to be home each visit?

No. Many recurring clients leave a key or entry code.

Can I skip a visit?

Yes — just let us know at least 48 hours ahead.
